name: Volar Plate Injury of the PIP Joint
tags: volar plate injury of the pip joint
definition: Hyperextension injury of the PIP joint causing volar plate sprain or avulsion, with risk of instability and stiffness.

investigations.principle: Radiographs assess avulsion fracture and alignment.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Buddy support or extension-block splint as appropriate
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Anguli-Sandhi/Snayu injury phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Hyperextension injury of the PIP joint causing volar plate sprain or avulsion, with risk of instability and stiffness.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
